title: Why Football Legends Still Can't Explain Haaland

lines.text: July 5th, 2026. A World Cup knockout game. Norway against Brazil.
lines.spoken: July the fifth, twenty twenty-six. A World Cup knockout game. Norway, against Brazil.
lines.tr: 5 Temmuz 2026. Dünya Kupası'nda eleme maçı. Norveç, Brezilya'ya karşı.
lines.hero: date set big over the stadium

lines.text: On 79 minutes, one man scores. Then, in the 90th minute, he scores again.
lines.spoken: On seventy-nine minutes, one man scores. Then, in the ninetieth minute, he scores again.
lines.tr: 79. dakikada bir adam gol atıyor. Sonra 90. dakikada bir gol daha.

lines.text: Brazil are out. Norway are in their first ever World Cup quarter-final.
lines.spoken: Brazil are out. Norway are in their first ever World Cup quarter-final.
lines.tr: Brezilya elendi. Norveç, tarihinde ilk kez Dünya Kupası'nda çeyrek finalde.

lines.text: His name is Erling Haaland. And even football's legends struggle to explain him.
lines.spoken: His name is Erling Haaland. And even football's legends struggle to explain him.
lines.tr: Adı Erling Haaland. Ve futbolun efsaneleri bile onu açıklamakta zorlanıyor.
lines.typed: WHY FOOTBALL LEGENDS STILL CAN'T EXPLAIN HAALAND

lines.text: It started in Leeds, England, on July 21st, 2000.
lines.spoken: It started in Leeds, England, on July the twenty-first, two thousand.
lines.tr: Her şey 21 Temmuz 2000'de, İngiltere'nin Leeds şehrinde başladı.

lines.text: His father, Alf-Inge Haaland, was a Premier League player, for Leeds and for Manchester City.
lines.spoken: His father, Alf-Inge Haaland, was a Premier League player, for Leeds, and for Manchester City.
lines.tr: Babası Alf-Inge Haaland, Premier Lig'de Leeds ve Manchester City formaları giymiş bir futbolcuydu.

lines.text: The family moved back to Bryne, a small town on Norway's west coast. That is where he learned the game.
lines.spoken: The family moved back to Bryne, a small town on Norway's west coast. That is where he learned the game.
lines.tr: Aile, Norveç'in batı kıyısındaki küçük Bryne kasabasına döndü. Futbolu orada öğrendi.

lines.text: May 2019. The Under-20 World Cup in Poland. Norway against Honduras.
lines.spoken: May, twenty nineteen. The Under-Twenty World Cup in Poland. Norway, against Honduras.
lines.tr: Mayıs 2019. Polonya'da 20 Yaş Altı Dünya Kupası. Norveç, Honduras'a karşı.

lines.text: He scores nine goals. In one game. No player had ever scored more than six in a match at the tournament.
lines.spoken: He scores nine goals. In one game. No player had ever scored more than six in a match at the tournament.
lines.tr: Tek maçta dokuz gol atıyor. O turnuvada daha önce kimse bir maçta altıdan fazla atamamıştı.

lines.text: Four months later, his first Champions League game, for Red Bull Salzburg. A hat-trick.
lines.spoken: Four months later, his first Champions League game, for Red Bull Salzburg. A hat-trick.
lines.tr: Dört ay sonra Red Bull Salzburg formasıyla ilk Şampiyonlar Ligi maçı. Hat-trick.

lines.text: In January 2020 he joined Borussia Dortmund.
lines.spoken: In January twenty twenty, he joined Borussia Dortmund.
lines.tr: Ocak 2020'de Borussia Dortmund'a geçti.

lines.text: On his debut, he came off the bench and scored a hat-trick in about twenty minutes.
lines.spoken: On his debut, he came off the bench, and scored a hat-trick in about twenty minutes.
lines.tr: İlk maçında yedek kulübesinden girdi ve yaklaşık yirmi dakikada hat-trick yaptı.

lines.text: In the end: eighty-six goals in eighty-nine games.
lines.spoken: In the end. Eighty-six goals, in eighty-nine games.
lines.tr: Toplamda: 89 maçta 86 gol.

lines.text: Every big club in Europe wanted him. In 2022, he chose his father's old club.
lines.spoken: Every big club in Europe wanted him. In twenty twenty-two, he chose his father's old club.
lines.tr: Avrupa'nın bütün büyük kulüpleri onu istiyordu. 2022'de babasının eski kulübünü seçti.
lines.hero: string from father card to City card

lines.text: Liverpool's Jürgen Klopp called him a real beast. And, unfortunately for Liverpool, a really good signing.
lines.spoken: Liverpool's Jurgen Klopp called him a real beast. And, unfortunately for Liverpool, a really good signing.
lines.tr: Liverpool'un hocası Jürgen Klopp ona gerçek bir canavar dedi. Ve ne yazık ki, Liverpool için, çok iyi bir transfer.

lines.text: In his first season, he scored thirty-six Premier League goals. A new record.
lines.spoken: In his first season, he scored thirty-six Premier League goals. A new record.
lines.tr: İlk sezonunda Premier Lig'de 36 gol attı. Yeni bir rekor.

lines.text: Alan Shearer and Andy Cole had held it at thirty-four. In seasons with forty-two games.
lines.spoken: Alan Shearer and Andy Cole had held it at thirty-four. In seasons with forty-two games.
lines.tr: Rekor, 34 golle Alan Shearer ve Andy Cole'daydı. Hem de 42 maçlık sezonlarda.

lines.text: Pep Guardiola had a name for him: the scoring machine.
lines.spoken: Pep Guardiola had a name for him. The scoring machine.
lines.tr: Pep Guardiola onun için bir isim bulmuştu: gol makinesi.

lines.text: That season, Manchester City won the Treble.
lines.spoken: That season, Manchester City won the Treble.
lines.tr: O sezon Manchester City üçlü kupayı kazandı.
lines.typed: PREMIER LEAGUE · FA CUP · CHAMPIONS LEAGUE

lines.text: But not everyone was convinced.
lines.spoken: But not everyone was convinced.
lines.tr: Ama herkes ikna olmamıştı.

lines.text: In 2024, Roy Keane said that in general play, Haaland looked almost like a League Two player.
lines.spoken: In twenty twenty-four, Roy Keane said that in general play, Haaland looked almost like a League Two player.
lines.tr: 2024'te Roy Keane, oyunun genelinde Haaland'ın neredeyse dördüncü lig oyuncusu gibi göründüğünü söyledi.
lines.typed: "ALMOST LIKE A LEAGUE TWO PLAYER" · ROY KEANE

lines.text: Haaland's reply was short: I really don't care about that man.
lines.spoken: Haaland's reply was short. I really don't care about that man.
lines.tr: Haaland'ın cevabı kısaydı: O adam gerçekten umurumda değil.

lines.text: Then came Premier League goal number one hundred. In only one hundred and eleven games.
lines.spoken: Then came Premier League goal number one hundred. In only one hundred and eleven games.
lines.tr: Sonra Premier Lig'deki 100. golü geldi. Sadece 111 maçta.

lines.text: Alan Shearer, the league's all-time top scorer, had needed one hundred and twenty-four.
lines.spoken: Alan Shearer, the league's all-time top scorer, had needed one hundred and twenty-four.
lines.tr: Ligin tüm zamanların golcüsü Alan Shearer'ın buna 124 maçı gerekmişti.

lines.text: Shearer said it himself: if Haaland stays long enough, there's no doubt he will break that record too.
lines.spoken: Shearer said it himself. If Haaland stays long enough, there's no doubt he will break that record too.
lines.tr: Shearer bunu kendisi söyledi: Haaland yeterince uzun kalırsa, o rekoru da kıracağına şüphe yok.
lines.typed: "NO DOUBT HE WILL BREAK THAT RECORD" · ALAN SHEARER

lines.text: For Norway, he became the country's all-time top scorer.
lines.spoken: For Norway, he became the country's all-time top scorer.
lines.tr: Norveç'te ise ülkesinin tüm zamanların en golcü oyuncusu oldu.

lines.text: First, Norway had to qualify for the World Cup. They won all eight games.
lines.spoken: First, Norway had to qualify for the World Cup. They won all eight games.
lines.tr: Önce Norveç'in Dünya Kupası'na katılması gerekiyordu. Sekiz maçın sekizini de kazandılar.

lines.text: Haaland scored in every one of them. Sixteen goals.
lines.spoken: Haaland scored in every one of them. Sixteen goals.
lines.tr: Haaland hepsinde gol attı. Toplam 16 gol.

lines.text: The last one was a 4-1 win over Italy in Milan. Norway's first World Cup in twenty-eight years.
lines.spoken: The last one was a four-one win over Italy, in Milan. Norway's first World Cup in twenty-eight years.
lines.tr: Sonuncusu Milano'da İtalya'ya karşı 4-1'lik galibiyetti. Norveç 28 yıl sonra ilk kez Dünya Kupası'nda.

lines.text: And at the World Cup itself, he did what he always does.
lines.spoken: And at the World Cup itself, he did what he always does.
lines.tr: Ve Dünya Kupası'nda, hep yaptığını yaptı.

lines.text: Two against Iraq. Two against Senegal. The winner against Ivory Coast. Two to knock out Brazil.
lines.spoken: Two against Iraq. Two against Senegal. The winner against Ivory Coast. Two to knock out Brazil.
lines.tr: Irak'a iki gol. Senegal'e iki gol. Fildişi Sahili'ne galibiyet golü. Brezilya'yı eleyen iki gol.

lines.text: England ended the run in the quarter-final. But he left with seven goals.
lines.spoken: England ended the run in the quarter-final. But he left with seven goals.
lines.tr: Çeyrek finalde İngiltere yolculuğu bitirdi. Ama o turnuvadan yedi golle ayrıldı.

lines.text: This season, he is the Premier League's top scorer again. Nine goals in eleven games.
lines.spoken: This season, he is the Premier League's top scorer again. Nine goals in eleven games.
lines.tr: Bu sezon yine Premier Lig'in gol kralı. 11 maçta 9 gol.

lines.text: Nine goals in one game at eighteen. A World Cup quarter-final at twenty-five. And he is only twenty-six.
lines.spoken: Nine goals in one game, at eighteen. A World Cup quarter-final, at twenty-five. And he is only twenty-six.
lines.tr: 18 yaşında bir maçta dokuz gol. 25 yaşında Dünya Kupası çeyrek finali. Ve henüz 26 yaşında.
lines.hero: pull back over the whole board

lines.text: Maybe that is why the legends can't explain him. He isn't finished yet.
lines.spoken: Maybe that is why the legends can't explain him. He isn't finished yet.
lines.tr: Belki de efsanelerin onu açıklayamamasının sebebi bu. Daha bitirmedi.

lines.text: Who will he become? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for the next one: Mbappé.
lines.spoken: Who will he become? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe, for the next one. Mbappé.
lines.tr: Sence nasıl bir efsane olacak? Yorumlarda yaz, sıradaki video için abone ol: Mbappé.

fact_notes: WC 2026 (ESPN fifa.world scoreboard): Norway-Iraq 16.06 Haaland 29',43'; Senegal-Norway 23.06 Haaland 48',58'; Ivory Coast-Norway 30.06 Haaland 86' winner; Brazil-Norway 05.07 Haaland 79',90', Neymar 90+10' (1-2); England-Norway QF 11.07 Bellingham 45+2',93'. 7 goals also Paddy Power 23.11.2026 + Klinpredict. First ever Norway WC quarter-final (Klinpredict + Norway history).
Born 21 July 2000, Leeds; father Alf-Inge Haaland (Leeds, Man City); raised in Bryne.
U20 WC 30 May 2019 Norway 12-0 Honduras, 9 goals; previous match record 6 (ESPN, CBS, FIFA, SI).
UCL debut hat-trick for Salzburg vs Genk, 17 Sep 2019 (widely reported).
Klopp May 2022: 'a real beast', 'unfortunately, a really good signing' (Goal.com, JOE).
36 PL goals 2022-23 record, previous 34 Shearer & Cole in 42-game seasons (AP/WTOP, SI).
Guardiola May 2023: 'the scoring machine Erling' (AP/WTOP, Gulf News).
100th PL goal in 111th appearance; Shearer 124 (ESPN AU, ExtraTimeTalk).
Shearer: 'If he stays for that long, no doubt he will break that record' (Goal.com, Sportskeeda).
Norway all-time top scorer (NBC Sports 21.11.2026, Paddy Power).
Dortmund debut Jan 2020 vs Augsburg: off the bench, hat-trick in ~20 min (widely reported).

Keane 'almost like a League Two player' in general play — Sky Sports, after City 0-0 Arsenal, end of March 2024 (Sportbible, Yahoo/Goal); Haaland: 'I really don't care about that man' (Yahoo, Sportbible).
WC qualifying 2025: 8 wins from 8, Haaland scored in all 8, 16 goals; 4-1 at Italy in Milan 16.11.2025; first WC since 1998 (ESPN, TSN, The Star, Arab News).
